description: Plan v7 section 8.3 runtime-limits clause, numeric side: all four numeric limits lowered to small exact values — precision 4, absolute scale 3, visible decimal places 2, compact exponent 2 — so all three numeric ingress paths named by plan section 4.6 can be pinned at one boundary. 'Counted' drives a cardinality-tagged generated placeholder, which reaches PluralOperands.validateNumericValue and DefaultStrings.validatePluralOperands (defined at DefaultStrings.java:1494, called at 1451 and 1479) with the INSTANCE limits; 'Positive' drives the same values through an expression OPERAND, which validates inside ExpressionEvaluator with the same limits but a different exception identity; and 'Literal' carries the numeric LITERAL 1.234, whose precision 4 and scale 3 sit exactly on the two lowered limits and are checked by ExpressionEvaluator.validateNumericLiteralTokens at compile time, so the fixture only builds if literals are measured identically. The only other literals are 0 and 1, well inside every lowered limit.
